title: Mean canopy height from NASA GEDI L3
source: Fix Planet map from NASA GEDI L3 mean RH100 canopy height, April 2019–March 2023, via NASA GIBS. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: Public domain (NASA). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: NASA colour scale for mean canopy height. No legend text in the image.

license: Public domain (NASA). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: NASA colour scale for aboveground biomass density. No legend text in the image.

title: MODIS MCD64 annual burned fraction, 2023
source: Fix Planet map from MODIS MCD64CMQ Collection 6.1 monthly burned area, summed for 2023 and divided by 0.25° cell area. University of Maryland fuoco distribution of MCD64A1. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: NASA MODIS MCD64A1, public distribution via the University of Maryland. Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Colour is the share of each cell burned in 2023. The scale saturates at 1. No legend text in the image.

title: FAO Global Ecological Zones, 2010
source: Fix Planet map from the FAO GEZ 2010 shapefile. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: FAO Global Ecological Zones. Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Zone classes are drawn as distinct colours. No class names are written on the image.

title: Share of planted forest and short-rotation plantation, 2015
source: Fix Planet map from Lesiv et al. 2022 global forest management, 100 m classes 31 and 32, share on a 0.02° grid. Oil palm (class 40) is not included. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: CC BY 4.0 (Lesiv et al.). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Colour is the share of each cell. No legend text in the image.

title: Living-biomass forest carbon, FAO FRA 2025
source: Fix Planet map from FAO FRA 2025 country tables. Aboveground plus belowground carbon, 2025, million tonnes. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: FAO Forest Resources Assessment country statistics. Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Log scale of million tonnes. Countries missing either pool stay grey. No legend text in the image.

title: Share of ESA WorldCover 2021 class 10, tree cover
source: Fix Planet map from ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200. Share of 10 m pixels in class 10 on a 0.02° grid. Mangroves (class 95) are not included. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: CC BY 4.0 (ESA WorldCover). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Colour is the share of each cell in class 10. No legend text in the image.

title: PEATMAP peat extent
source: Fix Planet map from PEATMAP (Xu et al. 2018). A 0.02° cell is marked when a peat polygon touches it. Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m.
license: CC BY 4.0 (Xu et al. / University of Leeds). Boundaries public domain (Natural Earth).
note: Presence only. No legend text in the image. Not the UNEP GPA 2022 status grid.
